$comment: Section 12 conformance matrix of the Originals Protocol, one entry per row, pinned to originals-spec master 19d3e82a0. Each row is covered by a test that references its id, or stays status=todo. status=partial means some layers are tested and the note says what remains; coveredBy lists the citing test files (checked by packages/vh/tests/conformance/registry.test.ts). Phases follow spec section 10 and plans/011. status=not-applicable means an owner decision makes the row moot pending a spec edit; its note names the decision. Ids are stable across re-pins: position is the row's place in the pinned table. Pinned rows are in table order, positions 1 to N; rows from open pull requests follow them, and two pull requests can each propose a row at the same position. A proposal can also insert rows between pinned ones, and reword pinned rows, whose note then gives the proposed wording. A row with `proposal` is not in the pinned table: it comes from the named open spec pull request, is implemented provisionally, and its position is its place in that pull request's table.
